produces: STRIDE table, mitigation list per threat, residual risk note

record_spec.gate_b_contrast: hollow instance: a threat list covering only 1-2 STRIDE categories for a data flow that crosses an authentication boundary is schema-conformant but reflects incomplete elicitation, not a completed threat model (issue-807 step2 audit).
record_spec.gate_c_axis_evaluation: see docs/handbooks/architecture-methodology.md, section 'Axis evaluation procedure — attack_potential' for the READ/EXECUTE/CRITERIA/CITATION method this role's axis_evaluation entries must follow: EXECUTE walks each data-flow-diagram element against all six STRIDE categories explicitly, per Adam Shostack, Threat Modeling: Designing for Security (Wiley, 2014), ch. 3-4 — the standard's actual elicitation method, not just its category enum.

recomputation.checked_by: TBD (follow-up — issue-521 out-of-scope note: per-role recomputation enforcement is a follow-up once evidence from real usage shows which roles need it)
recomputation.rule: overall risk verdict is derived per-threat, not asserted as one standalone summary field: each element's residual risk = severity as stated after mitigation is applied, never a role-asserted number independent of the listed threats and their mitigations (issue-515 invariant 4).

reference_resolution.rule: element must resolve to an actual system/data-flow element named elsewhere in the same record — no orphan references (issue-515 invariant 2). severity and status are free text: the Threat Dragon model schema (scout-brief.md, confirmed live fetch, resolving #515's prior open finding) carries these as present fields but does not define a closed vocabulary for either — an invented value list would violate the proposal's no-invented-enum constraint. Each axis_evaluation ref must resolve to a real entry inside this record carrying axis (must be in this role's judgment_axes), verdict (supports|contradicts|no-opinion), and citation (a docs/product/*.md entry path); when verdict is contradicts, the entry must also carry a finding object with target_path (must resolve against some role's write_scope) and a non-empty required_fix (issue-573 architecture proposal, sections 1 and 6).

record_spec.source_standard: STRIDE / OWASP Threat Dragon model schema (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OWASP/threat-dragon/main/ThreatDragonModels/demo-threat-model.json)

use_when.board_condition: a spec or design doc landed that introduces a new trust boundary, authentication surface, or sensitive-data flow AND no security-threat-model record exists yet for it

use_when: 스펙에 신뢰 경계·인증·민감데이터가 걸릴 때 (board_condition: a spec or design doc landed that introduces a new trust boundary, authentication surface, or sensitive-data flow AND no security-threat-model record exists yet for it)
